responsibility: Implements NetBSD target-specific builtin patching logic. It rewrites selected complex absolute-value builtins (cabsf, cabs, cabsl) to assembler names prefixed with __c99_, updating both explicit and implicit builtin declarations so GCC calls the NetBSD libc entry points that follow that naming convention. This file is a focused backend/helper implementation invoked from NetBSD target initialization.
same_name_distinction: Within the netbsd same-name group, this is the only executable implementation file: it contains the builtin-rewriting helper that renames cabs* builtins to __c99_* symbols, while gcc/config/netbsd.h provides the general NetBSD target macros/specs and gcc/config/netbsd.opt only declares the corresponding driver options.
